## Why This Is Asked

AS (val STRING) RETURNS STRING ->

    WHEN CURRENT_USER() IN ('analyst@tenant-b.com') THEN '***REDACTED***'

## Why This Is Asked
Assess ability to architect a real-time, cost-aware Azure data stack with schema drift handling, upserts, and governance.

## Key Concepts
- Event Hubs ingestion, ADLS Gen2 tiering
- Spark Structured Streaming, Delta Lake MERGE
- Schema drift handling with mergeSchema and late data via watermark
- Purview for lineage; cost controls via autoscale and partitioning
- Data quality gates (Deequ/constraints) in streaming jobs

## Code Example
```python
# PySpark snippet for incremental upserts into Delta Lake
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

def upsert(batch_df, batch_id):
    delta = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, "/mnt/delta/telemetry")
    delta.alias("t").merge(batch_df.alias("s"), "t.id = s.id") \
        .whenMatchedUpdate(set={"value": "s.value", "ts": "s.ts"}) \
        .whenNotMatchedInsertAll() \
        .execute()

streaming_df.writeStream.foreachBatch(upsert).start()
```

- How would you handle late-arriving schema changes in Delta Lake?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design an enterprise-grade streaming lakehouse with schema evolution, per-tenant isolation, and robust resilience across regions. It also covers data lineage, drift monitoring, and backfill strategies—critical for automotive telemetry.

## Key Concepts
- Schema Registry with evolution for streaming data
- Delta Lake on ADLS Gen2 with per-tenant partitions
- Handling schema drift and late-arriving data using MERGE upserts
- End-to-end data lineage in Purview
- Cross-region ADLS Gen2 replication
- 7-day timestamp-based backfill and replay
- Data quality and drift alerting

## Code Example
```python
# Pseudo-PySpark snippet showing validation against a schema registry
from pyspark.sql.functions import from_json, col
schema = registry.get_latest_schema("telemetry")
df = spark.readStream.format("eventhubs").load()
validated = df.select(from_json(col("body"), schema).alias("payload")).select("payload.*")
validated.writeStream.format("delta").option("checkpointLocation", "/chk/telemetry").partitionBy("tenant_id").start("/mnt/delta/telemetry")
```

- What failure scenarios require manual intervention, and how would you detect them in Purview lineage reports?
